claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows an electric pressure washer with wrapped cord/hose, but no usage hours, purchase date, or warranty/receipt details are visible.

claims.claim: No fault at all; motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not include a start-up test, pressure/spray consistency test, or any internal/motor inspection evidence.
No receipt or warranty card is shown in the witness observations.

claims.claim: Pre-certified to work at the peak of their performance landmarks.
claims.evidence: No certification document, test results, or performance readings are shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Not working or weak pressure (motor/valve/pump issues) — witness did not confirm it starts or sprays consistently.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the unit starting from cold, then continuous trigger spray for at least 1–2 minutes with a visible pressure gauge reading (or clear strong jet) and no unusual noises/smoke.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working; treated as a higher-risk used electric pressure washer pending a functional test.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (spray gun/lance/nozzle tips/attachments) — witness could not clearly see wand/nozzle types.
risks.proof: A clear photo/clip showing the full set laid out: spray gun, lance/wand, all nozzle tips, any hose connectors, and any included attachments—counted and matched to what’s in the box/bag.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown accessories; assume missing or not fully compatible attachments until shown.

risks.risk: Wear or damage at seals, hose ends, trigger/gun, or fittings (leaks) — no close-ups provided.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: trigger/gun connection points, hose end couplers, and any visible seals; plus a clip showing no leaks during operation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potential leak/maintenance needed; assume seals/fittings may require replacement.

risks.risk: Unknown voltage rating and motor specs (e.g., 220V vs 110V) affecting usability in Lagos.
risks.proof: A photo of the rating plate/label showing voltage (V), power (W), and model/serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown electrical specs; treated as potentially requiring confirmation or adapter/compatibility checks.

risks.risk: Cosmetic or structural issues not visible from one angle (cracks, rust, bent frame, damaged wheels/base).
risks.proof: Multiple photos from different angles: front, back, sides, base/wheels, and close-ups of any cracks/rust on the body and fittings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case cosmetic/structural condition consistent with typical used units when not fully documented.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the rating plate/label (voltage, power, model/serial).
Send a short video of the washer starting and spraying continuously for 1–2 minutes (no smoke, no abnormal noise), ideally with a pressure gauge reading if available.
Show all included accessories laid out (spray gun, lance/wand, nozzle tips, any attachments) and confirm what is missing.
Provide close-up photos of hose ends/couplers, trigger/gun, and any seals; include a leak-check clip while running.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item type as an electric pressure washer with a wheeled base and wrapped cord/hose, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. Seller statements about certification, usage, and fault-free status are not proven by the report, so the price should reflect functional and accessory uncertainty.
